"Ako ang Batas" -Gen. Tomas Karingal
(lit. I am the Law) is a 1990
Philippine
biographical
action
film directed by Francis "Jun" Posadas. The film stars
Eddie Garcia
in the title role and is based on the life of Gen.
Tomas Karingal
.

The movie depicts Karingal during
World War II
serving as the chief of the
Quezon City Police District
.
[
4
]
[
6
]
The film was producer Robbie Tan's entry to the
1990 Metro Manila Film Festival
.
